scripts/qa-ansible.bash:
#!/usr/bin/bash
echo "gate:qa-ansible.bash json=${QA_JSON_OUT:+1}" >> "$STUB_LOG"
code=0
[[ -f "$STUB_DIR/exit-qa-ansible.bash" ]] && code="$(cat "$STUB_DIR/exit-qa-ansible.bash")"
[[ "$code" == 0 ]] || echo "qa-ansible.bash: stub failure" >&2
exit "$code"
